answer: AI networks achieve Sybil resistance by coupling Proof-of-Stake with hardware-enclave attestations. Each agent binds its cryptographic identity to a physical basalt root of trust while staking collateral. Across a vast data ocean, the protocol aggregates valid state transitions into an oasis of cryptographically verified nodes. An attacker generating fake identities must incur linear hardware costs and stake capital, making identity multiplication economically unfeasible.
